blocks.tamil_translation: narrates: I asked Hazrat Aishah (RA) to tell me of some wondrous incident she had seen from Rasulullah ﷺ. "Which of the Prophet's ﷺ deeds was not wondrous! One night he came to me and lay down with me in bed. Then, saying, "Let me worship my Lord!" he got up from the bed, made wudu and stood up to pray. In the Salah he began to weep. The tears flowed down as far as his blessed chest. Then he made ruku', and in ruku' too he kept weeping in the same way. He made sajdah, and in it too he kept weeping in the same way; after rising from sajdah he still kept weeping, and this state continued until Hazrat Bilal (RA) came and called him for the Fajr Salah. I asked the Prophet ﷺ, "O Rasulullah, why do you weep so much? Allah has forgiven your former and later sins (even if they had occurred)!" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Should I not be a grateful servant?" and said, "How can I not worship when, today, from the ayah (إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّموَاتِ وَاْلاَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيتٍ لِّأُولِي اْلاَلْبَابِ) to the last ayah of Surah Aal-e-Imran has been revealed to me?'"

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا مِنِ امْرِءٍ تَكُونُ لَهُ صَلوةٌ بِلَيْلٍ فَغَلَبَهُ عَلَيْهَا نَوْمٌ إِلَّا كَتَبَ اللهُ لَهُ أَجْرَ صَلوتِهِ وَكَانَ نَوْمُهُ صَدَقَةً عَلَيْهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي باب من كان له صلاة بالليل....، رقم:١٧٨٥
blocks.tamil_translation: "Whoever has the habit of praying Tahajjud, and (on some night) is unable to wake up because sleep overpowers him, Allah writes for him the reward of having prayed Tahajjud.
